questions.question: Why was the original decision about the flooring for the new Level 4 office fit-out changed?
questions.answer_text: Before: Luxury vinyl plank flooring from Norvik Supply, because Mateo says vinyl plank costs about 20 percent less than carpet tile, is quick to replace, and Norvik can deliver within three weeks. Triggered by: Aisha (evidence): Aisha reports a pantry mock-up test in which planks with unsealed seams lifted and warped after 48 hours of repeated wet mopping. Elif (challenge): Elif argues the pantry and entrance will get spills and wet shoes every day, so open seams will lift, and the warranty excludes unsealed seams in wet areas. Tariq (reconsideration): Tariq says the mock-up result and the warranty exclusion mean the flooring decision needs another look before ordering. After: Norvik vinyl plank with heat-sealed seams and a ceramic tile band across the pantry and entrance zones, because Sven says keeping vinyl plank but having Norvik heat-seal the seams and putting a ceramic tile band across the pantry and entrance zones fixes the moisture problem without paying for tile everywhere.
